key_idea: Match each part of the house to a piece by its shape and colour.
steps: The house has a blue wall, a yellow roof and a green door.
The blue wall matches the blue square piece. The yellow roof matches the yellow triangle.
The green door matches the green rectangle.
The pink circle is not used anywhere in the house.

choice_feedback.A: The blue square piece is used. It is the wall of the house.
choice_feedback.B: The yellow triangle is used. It is the roof.
choice_feedback.C: The green rectangle is used. It is the door.
choice_feedback.E: There is no pink square among Mr Beaver's pieces.

review.note: Key D is confirmed by the blind solver. But the house is not an exact rearrangement: its wall (170x150, not a square) and roof (210 wide) are larger than the loose square (110x110) and triangle (120 wide), and the door is shorter. Explanation matches by shape and colour only; consider redrawing so the pieces have the same size.
